subject: Request: pilot onboarding — invoice-only / PO waiver for Atlas BioLabs
messages:
From: Michelle Park <michelle@atlasbiolabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding request — can we do invoice-only (no PO)?

Hi Vivek / Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Atlas BioLabs is excited to run a 6-week pilot of Redwood for inference on our internal annotation tooling. We expect spend ~USD 12k for the pilot (monthly invoices).

Procurement at Atlas requires a PO for most vendors. Given the pilot size, our procurement lead asked whether Redwood can accept invoice-only / temporary no-PO billing (we can provide a PO for any committed spend after pilot).

Attached: onboarding form + signed MSA for pilot.

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to accept invoices for this pilot without a PO, and if any evidence or approvals you need on your side? We also need a billing contact and an invoice format example.

Thanks,
Michelle Park
Partnerships Manager
Atlas BioLabs
michelle@atlasbiolabs.com

Attachment stubs: Atlas_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Atlas_MSA_signed.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Park <michelle@atlasbiolabs.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding request — can we do invoice-only (no PO?)

Hi Michelle — great to hear, and glad the demo was useful.

Short answer: we can sometimes accommodate invoice-only pilot arrangements, but we need to run this through our procurement exceptions process and collect a couple of items first. To help speed things up, could you please confirm:

- Total expected spend for the pilot (you mentioned ~$12k — is that the cap?)
- Billing entity and remit-to address (accounts@atlasbiolabs.com is fine if that's the AP mailbox)
- Will Atlas sign a short SOW (1–2 pages) that references the MSA for the pilot scope?

I'll loop in Procurement (Priyom) to start the exception evaluation. Typical evidence we ask for: onboarding form, signed MSA, a quick vendor risk assessment (if available), and the AP contact.

If you can send the onboarding form and a contact for invoicing, I'll push this through today.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vivek.k@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot onboarding request — Atlas BioLabs — PO waiver request (pilot)

Team — forwarding a pilot request from Atlas BioLabs that asks for invoice-only billing (no PO) for an estimated USD 12k pilot. Vivek is the EAE. Attachments include the onboarding form and a signed MSA.

Summary / ask:
- Pilot cap: USD 12,000 (estimated)
- Contract: standard Redwood MSA signed (attached)
- Requested path: invoice-only for pilot; vendor wants invoices to accounts@atlasbiolabs.com
- Risk notes: Atlas is a Series B life-sciences startup; they passed initial SOC-lite questionnaire last quarter. I attach a short vendor risk checklist I completed based on our intake.

Requesting procurement exception approval to onboard Atlas on an invoice-only temporary path for the pilot period. Proposed guardrails if approved:
- Timebox: 90 days from first invoice
- Spend cap: align to pilot cap (USD 12k) — any extension requires PO or re-approval
- Invoicing cadence: monthly

Please advise authority level required. If approval is possible, I'll add them to the temporary vendor allowlist and share invoice instructions to the Atlas AP team.

Attachments: Atlas_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Atlas_Risk_Assessment.xlsx, Atlas_MSA_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom
Vendor Onboarding / Procurement
priyom.d@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Sep 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding request — Atlas BioLabs — PO waiver request (pilot)

Thanks Priyom — I reviewed the attachments and did a quick risk triage. Notes:

- MSA: executed copy present; no deviation flagged in the commercial redlines.
- Risk assessment: low-to-moderate risk (startup, no enterprise billing history).
- Finance: we need a budget center and GL code to route invoices; ask Vivek to confirm customer budget code for this engagement.

Authority guidance: per our current policy, managers can approve invoice-only vendor exceptions up to USD 15,000 for trials. Exceptions above that threshold require director-level signoff. The ask here is ~USD 12k which is within manager authority, but we should document it on the exception form and set the 90-day timebox.

To proceed I need:
1) Written confirmation of the pilot cap (Vivek)
2) Budget center / GL code the customer will use (Vivek) or confirm Redwood billing code to charge against (sales ops)
3) Copy of SOW or one-page statement of work referencing MSA (vendor or Vivek)

If items above are provided, I can record the exception and add Atlas to the temporary invoice-only allowlist. Please note: if final invoices exceed USD 15k we will need director approval retroactively (we should avoid that).

Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Analyst
naomi.f@redwood.com

On Fri, Sep 3, 2027 at 2:30 PM Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding a pilot request from Atlas BioLabs that asks for invoice-only billing (no PO) for an estimated USD 12k pilot.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Park <michelle@atlasbiolabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Sep 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding request — Atlas BioLabs — PO waiver request (pilot)

Michelle — thanks for the materials and patience while we reviewed internally.

Decision: Redwood will approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding path for Atlas BioLabs for the pilot under the following conditions:

- Approved spend cap: USD 20,000 total for the pilot period (note we set a slightly higher buffer than the requested 12k to avoid an immediate re-approval if scope creeps).
- Timebox: 90 days from first invoice date.
- Invoicing: monthly invoices to accounts@atlasbiolabs.com referencing SOW ATB-2027-PILOT-01 and remit details.
- Required docs: we need the one-page SOW (signed or acknowledged by Atlas), and the vendor onboarding form retained in procurement records.
- Finance items: please provide the customer's budget center or confirm Redwood billing code 44-512 for charge routing.

Once we have the SOW and the budget info, Procurement (Naomi) will add Atlas to the temporary vendor allowlist and Finance will accept invoices up to the USD 20k cap during the 90-day window. Any invoices that cause cumulative charges >USD 20k will require director-level approval and may be paused.

Vivek — please confirm pilot cap and share the SOW when available. Priyom / Naomi — I'll document this exception in the vendor exceptions tracker and send a brief approval note to Finance.

Michelle — we appreciate you working with us on this. If you want, we can get a short SOW template over to you and the AP contact for invoice samples.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.b@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: SOW-draft.docx
